title: Scan
description: A flatbed scanner with its lid open and a magazine page of sky on the glass, a slip of newsprint laid over it. Press Scan or pull the head across by hand: a cyan-white light bar sweeps under the paper and the preview rebuilds line by line, with halftone moiré, colour fringing and the dust on the glass.
intent: Turn the scanner itself into the lo-fi effect: what you lay on the glass is printed matter with a real halftone screen, and the scan resamples it into moiré, misregistered colour and dust the way a cheap flatbed does.
sources: herb reference board: 039a, it must be out there. on a scanned sky
